proofs.text: Build a project with one marked pytest test and run `--all --quick`; verify exit 0, that `.purlin/runtime/proofs/feat.unit.json` holds one entry with `id: "PROOF-1"`, `test_file: "tests/test_feat.py"`, `status: "pass"` and exactly the seven fields, and that `specs/a/` holds no file other than the spec

rule_text: `--quick` runs one arm per resolved framework and the evidence lands in `.purlin/runtime/proofs/<feature>.<tier>.json`; nothing is written under `specs/`

tests.body:
def test_pytest_arm_writes_the_runtime_proof_file(self, tmp_path):
        root = _pytest_project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        code, output = _run(root, '--all', '--quick')
        data = _proofs(root, 'feat')
        assert data is not None, output
        assert data['tier'] == 'unit'
        assert [e['id'] for e in data['proofs']] == ['PROOF-1']
        entry = data['proofs'][0]
        assert entry['test_file'] == 'tests/test_feat.py'
        assert entry['status'] == 'pass'
        assert set(entry) == {'feature', 'id', 'rule', 'test_file',
                              'test_name', 'status', 'tier'}
        assert code == 0, output
tests.name: test_pytest_arm_writes_the_runtime_proof_file

def test_the_proof_file_is_not_written_under_specs(self, tmp_path):
        root = _pytest_project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        _run(root, '--all', '--quick')
        stray = [name for name in os.listdir(str(root / 'specs' / 'a'))
                 if not name.endswith('.md')]
        assert stray == []
tests.name: test_the_proof_file_is_not_written_under_specs
